semantics: UNDERCAST completes the maintained Star Trek species estate one species at a time. Exactly one species may be active. No later species may begin population or media mutation until the active species has a merged-main and live-deployment gold receipt.

gold_contract.exact_species_eligibility: Every captured named performer-role row is independently adjudicated from an exact retained source revision. Category membership alone is never sufficient.
gold_contract.eligible_named_credits_filed: Every reviewed eligible named performer-role credit has a dedicated or exact additional-performance canonical filing; reviewed category exclusions remain visible and count separately.
gold_contract.character_stills_complete: Every primary species card has an exact character still. Repeated online provenance passes are mandatory; a contributor screencap with production, episode or film, timestamp, playback source, capture date and uncropped original is the fallback.
gold_contract.performer_portraits_complete: Every primary species card has an attributable unmasked performer portrait from a source that identifies the person. A production frame is not a performer portrait.
gold_contract.media_review_debt_zero: Every species media facet is exact-subject verified; absent, review and attention dispositions are not gold.
gold_contract.source_and_preservation_green: Exact source receipts, archive contract, collection policy and preservation export are green on the exact candidate head.
gold_contract.published_receipt: The species is gold only after the same assertions pass against the exact merged main commit and the live GitHub Pages deployment.

sequence.label: Ferengi
sequence.note: The reviewed eligible Ferengi card catalog is filed. Torrot / Jeri Ryan and the withdrawn Nandi / Melissa Villaseñor credit remain explicit exclusions; media completion is the active gold blocker.

sequence.label: Jem'Hadar
sequence.note: All captured named credits are filed; media completion waits behind Ferengi.

sequence.label: Tellarite
sequence.note: All reviewed eligible credits are filed; Dal R'El / Kate Mulgrew remains a reviewed category exclusion. Media completion waits behind Jem'Hadar.
